parent_objective: design a fresh public repeat for corrected profile trends after M1209 seed fragility and control-parity audit
blocked_by: M1209 trends are seed-fragile and cannot justify longer training or paper-level interpretation without a fresh public repeat
supersedes: directly scaling M1209 into longer training
invalidates: treating M1209 single public seed block as stable architecture evidence

public_gates: M1211 may design a repeat protocol only
M1211 must use a fresh public training seed block and fresh public eval seed block
M1211 must keep the same corrected profile configs and budget unless a documented resource cap requires a smaller fixed subset
M1211 must not use private holdout
M1211 must not claim paper-level evidence or self-identification
forbidden_shortcuts: do not tune profiles based on M1209
do not claim recurrent-hidden benefit before the repeat
do not claim finite-window history necessity before the repeat

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: pre-registers a fresh public repeat to separate stable architecture trends from lucky training seeds
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: design only; no training promotion private-holdout paper-level generalization recurrent-belief or self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if repeat changes profile-specific budgets after seeing M1209
stop if private holdout is proposed
stop if design omits required controls without a fixed resource reason
fallback_plan: route to full corrected repeat if resources are sufficient
route to fixed subset repeat only if documented resource cap requires it
route to branch synthesis if repeat is no longer the best next step
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1210 audit identifies seed fragility and control parity

admission_evidence: M1209 completed the corrected public pilot with all seed runs complete
M1210 audited L2/current-tiled and L3/reset-control implications
M1210 found seed fragility that requires a fresh public repeat before stronger claims
blocked_shortcuts: do not make paper-level or self-ID claims
allowed_updates: status, queue, scoreboard, research log, review, and next manifest
next_stage_criteria: fresh repeat seed and eval blocks are fixed
profile set and budget are fixed
next repeat run milestone is selected

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1211 must preserve current-tiled controls because M1210 keeps current-frame substitution risk active.
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: Repeat design may test stability of public trends but still cannot prove causal self-ID.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If the repeat again shows L2/current-tiled parity or L3/reset parity, record it as negative evidence and route to architecture or task redesign.
allowed_claims: no recurrent-belief, strong self-identification, promotion, private-holdout, real-vehicle, or paper-result claim

hypothesis: A fresh public repeat protocol can test whether M1209 L3-family and L2-control trends are stable rather than seed-block artifacts.
success_criteria: fresh training seed base and eval seed base are fixed
profile set and budget are fixed
interpretation rules for repeat outcomes are written
no training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, profile tuning, or actor-input contract expansion occurs
failure_criteria: profile-specific budgets are changed based on M1209 results
repeat design omits corrected controls without justification
self-identification is claimed from public pilot aggregates

commands.name: design_corrected_profile_repeat
commands.command: write fresh public repeat protocol without training

decision_rule: M1211 passes if a fixed fresh public repeat is pre-registered without training or claim expansion.
